title: intent critic answers outside a project, indistinguishably from inside one
body:
dc, 2026-09-12, driving the keg: `intent init --name` is not v3's spelling and refused at rc 1, and `intent critic` in the uninitialised directory then produced output indistinguishable from a project's, because the rule library resolves from the install root. Every other verb refuses outside a project; whether critic should is hv's to say. Carried in `intent/wip.md` until 2026-09-13.



**CLOSED 2026-09-14 21:05Z (ic, on vc's ruling: critic refuses outside a project like every other verb).** Fixed in the commit carrying this note. `intent critic` outside a project now returns the refusal every other verb gives, the project error's own rendering with its remedy, at exit 1. It comes after critic's own usage refusals, so an unknown language, severity or `--format` still exits 2 anywhere; `--format` is now validated before the run for that reason. `--languages` still answers anywhere. A project whose config will not read still only warns (AC-00.6). Proved by `critic_refuses_outside_a_project_after_its_usage_refusals`; critic_surface's `--staged` test now stands in a project, as critic requires.
